purpose: Source-authored contract for Inferno law profiles that require exact gated-entry identity semantics. This is static traceability only and does not authorize gameplay mutation.
validationState: source-prepared-static-only; runtime proof is still required before gameplayAllowed can become true.

forbiddenSubstitutes: Inferno faction membership counted as gated entry identity
gatedOrSummoned unit tag counted as gated entry proof
permanent recruited Inferno unit counted as gated entry identity
teleport movement counted as gated entry identity without Gating spawn proof
summoned unit existence without entry transaction proof counted as gated identity
fire damage or fire spell counted as gated identity
damage event without acting gated stack proof counted as gated identity
RequiresGatedIdentity.notes: Infernal Ascension requires exact Gating spawn/entry identity before gated-entry damage can apply. Unit tags, Inferno membership, fire theming, teleport movement, and ordinary damage events are context only; gameplay still requires entry transaction identity, acting stack identity, owner correlation, permanent recruited unit exclusion, committed damage ordering, and idempotence proof.

requiredRuntimeProof: gating spawn or entry transaction proof
idempotent per-entry or per-attack application proof
